title: trimezia liebmannii

It is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America, used for its medicinal and ornamental purposes. The health benefits of Trimezia liebmannii include its potential to reduce inflammation and anxiety, thanks to its therapeutic actions, which include sedative and anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, iridoids, and other compounds, although further research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
